purpose: Build an auditable revenue and margin proxy sequence for CCL material names where product-level ASP is unavailable.

records.interpretation: Nanya is the strongest official public proxy for price/mix pass-through because inquiry response discloses revenue, cost, gross margin, unit selling price, unit cost, margin contribution and raw-material price changes. It still does not disclose M8/M9/M10 ASP or revenue split.

input_cost_proxy.annual_report_comment: From 2025Q4, AI demand drew copper foil and glass-cloth suppliers toward high-end copper foil and Low DK cloth; Low DK cloth demand squeezed thin glass-cloth capacity and prices rose 10%-20% per month; copper foil prices rose sharply.

records.interpretation: Shengyi has segment-level revenue and gross-margin improvement plus official raw-material tightness commentary, but no public product-level ASP or M8/M9/M10 revenue share.

records.metric_scope: CCL segment and high-speed CCL product mix

input_cost_proxy.official_comment: Official annual/interim filings state high-speed CCL focuses on AI server, switch and optical-module applications, with Ultra low loss and Extreme low loss certification/batch-order progress.
